sloka: मुनेर् वचनम् अक्लीबम् श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मजः ।राघवः प्राञ्जलिः भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच दृढव्रतः ॥१-२६-१॥
transliteration: muner vacanam aklībam śrutvā naravarātmajaḥ ।rāghavaḥ prāñjaliḥ bhūtvā pratyuvāca dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥1-26-1॥

translations.english: After listening to the manly command of ascetic Viswamitra, Rama, of the lineage of Raghu, the son of the foremost of men and firm in determination, replied with folded palms:
